name: Bandit Camp (Wilderness)
accessNote: The Bandit Camp east of the Ruins in the Wilderness (around level 14-20) holds the level 22 and level 130 bandits assigned by Krystilia. The bandits are aggressive to all players, so approach with caution. Multicombat, cannon placement and safespots are not wiki-stated for this camp, so conservative defaults are used. This is a PvP zone; bring Wilderness-appropriate risk gear.
